prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: polished landscape editorial illustration for the existing HoTLinE Doc Thai hotel permit web application, used at the bottom of a mint-colored welcome panel and assessment result card.
Primary request: Create an original welcoming Phuket boutique hotel garden illustration inspired by the user's reference style: elegant softly painted architectural watercolor, warm ivory three-story small hotel, symmetrical facade, dark teal window frames and balconies, warm sand path leading to the entrance, tropical palms and lush low foliage, softly layered mint and blue-green hills in the distance.
Composition: one cohesive landscape scene, approximately 3:2 aspect ratio. Entire hotel and palms visible, hotel centered, scene occupies lower 80%, quiet pale mint sky above, soft edge atmosphere. Foreground plants frame an open welcoming central path. Designed to remain legible at 450px wide.
Style: refined hand-painted gouache and watercolor with clean architectural details, subtle paper texture, restrained depth, tasteful Thai hospitality brochure, not cartoon mascot, not photorealistic.
Palette: warm cream, muted sage, pale mint, soft dusty teal, limited dark navy accents; no saturated primary colors.
Background: solid very pale mint (#F0FBF9) fading naturally into the top of the illustration. Opaque image.
Constraints: NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO signs with writing, NO logos, NO watermarks, NO people, NO UI, NO frame. Website text will be real HTML. This is a new original illustration, not a screenshot.

prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: subtle horizontal architectural illustration for the page heading of a Thai hotel permit web application.
Primary request: A graceful small modern four-story hotel seen in gentle three-quarter perspective, clean balconies, roof terrace, a palm tree on each side, low tropical shrubs at the base. Evoke the user's very pale blue hotel illustration reference for sustainable hospitality.
Style: minimal delicate architectural pencil-and-watercolor wash, simplified clearly spaced shapes, pale desaturated blue-gray linework and mint washes. Nearly monochrome, light and airy, far less detailed than a full scenic painting. A single architectural vignette, not an icon.
Composition: landscape approximately 3:2. Entire hotel and palms centered and completely visible with generous clear margins; no cropped roof or trees. Intended to display 250px wide next to a headline.
Palette: very pale powder blue, muted mint, light blue-gray outlines. No dark outlines or black. No realistic shadows.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the building, palms and small baseline; no sky, no mountains, no surrounding rectangle. Retain clean soft edges.
Constraints: NO text or lettering anywhere, NO hotel sign, NO logos, NO watermark, NO UI, NO people, NO photo, NO frame. Web copy is added as HTML separately.
